09:21 - Mexican inspired salad
Creamy cashew sauce:
- 1 cup raw cashews, soaked in boiling water for 15 mins and then drained
- 2 tsp veggie stock powder
- 2 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp dried cumin
- 3 tbsp nutritional yeast
- 2 tbsp sriracha
- 2 tsp lemon juice
- 1/4 cup water + more if needed (adjust as you go)
Cucumber tomato salad:
- 1 cucumber, finely chopped
- 2 tomatoes, finely chopped
- pinch of salt & pepper
- 1 tsp olive oil
Beans & corn:
- 1 tsp olive oil
- 1 x 400g can black beans, drained and rinsed
- 1 x 400g can corn kernels, drained and rinsed
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp dried cumin
- pinch of salt & pepper
Also:
- pickled onions
- cos lettuce

11:25 - Sticky lemon & garlic tofu
- 500g firm tofu, torn into chunks
- 2 tbsp corn flour
- 1 tbsp olive oil, for frying the tofu
- 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
- 2 handfuls of green beans, ends cut off
- sesame seeds, sprinkled on top
Sauce:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1/3 cup soy sauce
- 1/4 cup lemon juice
- 4 cloves of garlic, crushed

14:17 - Hearty vegan lasagne
"Mince":
- 200g TVP (textured vegetable protein)
- 2 tsp vegan beef stock powder
- 2 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 1/2 tsp dried chilli powder
- 2 cups boiling water
Tomato sauce:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1 brown onion, diced
- 3 garlic cloves, finely diced
- all of the "mince"
- 1 x 400g can crushed tomatoes
- 1 cup passata
- 1 cup water
- 2 tsp veggie stock powder
- 1 tsp white sugar
- salt and pepper, to taste
Creamy sauce:
- 2 tbsp vegan butter
- 2 tbsp plain flour
- 2 + 1/2 cups soy milk
- 1/4 cup nutritional yeast
- 1 tbsp white miso paste
- salt and pepper, to taste
And also:
- 1 zucchini, finely sliced into rectangles
- 200g fresh spinach
- 250g lasagne sheets

16:51 - Raspberry oat bars
Crumble layer/s:
- 1 cup oats
- 1 cup plain flour
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 2/3 cup melted vegan butter
- pinch of salt
Raspberry layer:
- 250g frozen raspberries
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup white sugar
- 2 tbsp corn flour mixed with 3 tbsp water
Also:
- 100g dark chocolate, into chunks

INGREDIENTS 

#1 Peanut Sweet Potato Stew 0:54

1 red bell pepper
1-2 onions
1 tbsp chopped ginger
3 cloves garlic 
2 tablespoons olive, vegetable oil
½ tsp each: cumin, black pepper, cinnamon, coriander
¼ tsp cayenne pepper, or to taste
½ tsp salt, or to taste
2 tbsp tomato paste
400g chopped tomatoes (14oz can)
1- 2 medium sweet potatoes
1 large handful roasted unsalted peanuts
400g chickpeas  (14oz can)
750ml (3 cups) vegetable broth, more if needed
1-2 leeks, chopped or a few handfuls spinach added towards the end
3-4 tbsp natural creamy peanut butter
2 tbsp lemon juice, or more to taste
1 handful fresh herbs

→ serve with cooked rice, wraps, sesame seeds, roasted peanuts, fresh veggies…

→ serves 4 



#2 Tofu Burger Patties 2:57

400g firm tofu (14oz)
1 medium sized onion, minced
1-2 cloves garlic, minced
1⁄2 cup quick cooking oats (45g)
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1-2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
salt, pepper to taste
2 tbsp cornstarch
a few tbsp vegetable oil for frying

→ yields ~ 8 patties


#3 Berry Breakfast Crumble Bars 4:16

180g quick cooking oats (2 cups)
1 ½ tbsp ground flax seeds
60g all-purpose flour (½ cup)
1 tsp baking powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp cinnamon
50g coconut oil, melted (3 ½ tbsp measured cold)
2 ½ tbsp applesauce
1 tsp vanilla extract or a few drops vanilla aroma
3 tbsp maple syrup
1 tbsp white wine vinegar (think i forgot to mention!?)

for the filling:
210 g frozen raspberries (1 ⅓ cups)
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp maple syrup
1 tsp cornstarch mixed into 3 tbsp water

→ yields a 20cm (8 inch) square baking pan 


#4 Tofu Enchiladas 6:40

for the sauce:
2 tbsp olive oil
½ tsp chili powder* (or to taste)
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp black pepper
½ tsp cumin
½ tsp coriander
80g tomato paste (⅓ cup plus 1 tsp)
1-2 tsp syrup or sugar
2 tbsp flour
1 ⅓ cup vegetable broth (330ml), more if needed

for the filling:
1 onion
1 leek
300g smoked tofu (10,6oz)
1-2 tbsp oil for the pan
¼ cup white wine/soju/vegetable broth for deglazing
1-2 tbsp soy sauce

6-8 small to medium tortillas 

150g vegan cheese (5.3oz)
1 can black beans (14oz = 400g)


*how much chili depends on your taste but also on the type of chili you’re using. for instance birds eye VERY spicy, gochugaru not as spicy.

→ yields 6-8 enchiladas


#5 Whipped Bean Cookie Dough 11:01

1 cup oats, (90g)
¼ cup (60ml) agave or maple syrup, if needed 1-2 more tsp 
1 tsp vanilla or a few drops aroma
¼ tsp salt
1 can white beans, (400g = 14oz)
2 ½ tbsp vegan butter, melted (measured cold)
2-3 tbsp non dairy milk
¼  - 1/3 cup chocolate chips  (40-50g)

→ serves 4-6


#6 Two Overnight Focaccias 12:47

2 cups water (500ml)
2 tbsp agave syrup
2 tbsp olive oil to be added to the water
2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast 
630g all-purpose flour or bread flour (5 ¼ cups)
3 tsp salt 
2 tbsp of olive oil to grease your baking tins with
2 tbsp of olive oil to be added on top of the dough before baking (1 tbsp per pan)
a generous sprinkle of flakey sea salt 

→ BAKE for 25-30 Minutes in a preheated oven at 190C
→ yields 2 focaccias, baked in 2 baking dishes around 20 - 25 cm in diameter
